wikipedia.extract: Bourke's parrot (Neopsephotus bourkii, formerly known as Neophema bourkii), also known as the blue-vented parrot, sundown parrot, pink-bellied parrot, Bourke's parakeet, Bourke or "Bourkie", is a small parrot found in Australia and the only species in its genus, Neopsephotus. It is approximately 19 cm long and weighs around 45 grams.
wikipedia.title: Bourke's parrot

commonNames.name: Gee’s Golden Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Gee's golden langur (Trachypithecus geei), also known as simply the golden langur, is an Old World monkey found in a small region of Western Assam, India and the neighboring foothills of the Black Mountains of Bhutan. Long considered sacred by many Himalayan people, the golden langur was first brought to the attention of the Western world by the naturalist Edward Pritchard Gee in the 1950s.
wikipedia.title: Gee's golden langur

commonNames.name: Golden-brown Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus ravelobensis Zimmerman, Ehresmann, Zeitemann, Radespiel, Randrianambinina & Rakotoarison, 1997

wikipedia.extract: The golden-brown mouse lemur (Microcebus ravelobensis), also known as the (Lac) Ravelobe mouse lemur, is part of the Cheirogaleidae family, and the smallest species of lemur. It is arboreal, nocturnal and usually social.
wikipedia.title: Golden-brown mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Melignomon is a genus of birds in the family Indicatoridae.
wikipedia.title: Melignomon

wikipedia.extract: The bird family Tytonidae, which includes the barn owls Tyto and the bay owls Phodilus, is one of the two families of owls, the other being the true owls or typical owls, Strigidae. Tytonidae are medium to large owls with large heads and characteristic heart-shaped faces.
wikipedia.title: Tytonidae

wikipedia.extract: Baryphthengus is a genus of birds in the family Momotidae. They are found in forests of South and Central America.
wikipedia.title: Baryphthengus

wikipedia.extract: Neomorphus is a genus of terrestrial cuckoos in the family Cuculidae. Despite their relatively large size, they are highly inconspicuous and rarely seen.
wikipedia.title: Neomorphus

wikipedia.extract: Syrrhaptes is a genus of birds in the sandgrouse family. The genus name is from Ancient Greek surrhaptos, "sewn together"; the feathered toes of birds in this genus are fused together.
wikipedia.title: Syrrhaptes

commonNames.name: De Brazza’s Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: De Brazza's monkey (Cercopithecus neglectus) is an Old World monkey endemic to the riverine and swamp forests of central Africa. The largest species in the guenon family, it is one of the most widespread arboreal African primates.
wikipedia.title: De Brazza's monkey

commonNames.name: Kites, Old World Vultures, Eagles, and Hawks

wikipedia.extract: The Accipitridae () is one of the four families within the order Accipitriformes, and is a family of small to large birds of prey with strongly hooked bills and variable morphology based on diet. They feed on a range of prey items from insects to medium-sized mammals, with a number feeding on carrion and a few feeding on fruit.
wikipedia.title: Accipitridae

commonNames.name: White Bald-headed Uakari
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The bald uakari (Cacajao calvus) or bald-headed uakari is a small New World monkey characterized by a very short tail, a bright, crimson face, bald head, and long coat. The bald uakari is restricted to várzea forests and other wooded habitats near water in the western Amazon of Brazil and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Bald uakari

wikipedia.extract: Telacanthura is a genus containing two species of swift in the family Apodidae that are found in Africa.
wikipedia.title: Telacanthura

wikipedia.extract: Sylviornithidae is an extinct family of flightless birds, known from subfossil bones found in Holocene aged deposits on the Melanesian islands of New Caledonia and Fiji. For many years it was considered a monotypic family consisting of the New Calendonia Sylviornis alone, but recent studies show that the Fijian Megavitiornis was part of this clade as well.
wikipedia.title: Sylviornithidae

wikipedia.extract: Eocuculus cherpinae is a prehistoric bird, known from postcranial remains from the late Eocene Florissant beds in Colorado.
wikipedia.title: Eocuculus

commonNames.name: Madame Fleurette’s Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur fleuretae Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Fleurette's sportive lemur (Lepilemur fleuretae), or the Andohahela sportive lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. Like all members of its genus, it is nocturnal, and largely folivorous.
wikipedia.title: Fleurette's sportive lemur

wikipedia.extract: Ardipithecus is a genus of extinct hominine that lived during the Late Miocene and Early Pliocene epochs in the Afar Depression, Ethiopia. Originally described as one of the earliest ancestors of humans after they diverged from the last common ancestor shared with chimpanzees, the relation of this genus to human ancestors and whether it is a hominin is now a matter of debate.
wikipedia.title: Ardipithecus

wikipedia.extract: The Actinomycetota (previously known as "Actinobacteria") are a diverse phylum of Gram-positive bacteria with high guanine-cytosine content (GC content or G+C content). They can be terrestrial or aquatic.
wikipedia.title: Actinomycetota

wikipedia.extract: Nannopterum is a genus of cormorant comprising three species. They are found throughout the Americas, hence the common name American cormorants.
wikipedia.title: Nannopterum

commonNames.name: Angola Dwarf Galago
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Galagoides kumbirensis Svensson, Bersacola, Mills, Munds, Nijman, Perkin et al., 2017

wikipedia.extract: The Angolan dwarf galago (Galagoides kumbirensis) is a species of dwarf galago native to Angola, and was named after western Angolan Kumbira Forest. Though 36 individuals of the Angolan dwarf galago were identified in September 2013, it was declared as a new species in 2017, and is now the nineteenth species of galago to be identified.
wikipedia.title: Angolan dwarf galago
